title: Another person can discard the uploader's journal-import check
rootCause: The backend lets any holder of JOURNAL_REJECT discard someone else's checked import (JournalImportService.discard), and the read-only view offers Discard. Script/spec say only the uploader can discard; the uploader is not told.
suggestedFix: Decide the rule. If only the uploader may discard: refuse in the backend and hide Discard in the read-only view. If JOURNAL_REJECT may: update spec/script and tell the uploader who discarded it.

findings.device: iPad mini landscape (Bjørn); iPad Pro 13 portrait (Ola)
findings.text: Read-only view says "Only Anna Lindh, who uploaded the file, can create these journals." but offers Discard; Bjørn's Discard succeeded (DB discarded_by Bjorn Eriksson). Anna's Create then refused: "This check was discarded. Nothing was created."
Ola (Owner) gets the same read-only view with Discard offered (not pressed).
Builder decision 25: notice and no Create confirmed, but Discard offered to others and works → change.

title: Submit accepted for a Reverse-automatically journal while Recurring journals is off
rootCause: Entitlement is checked on save-draft and post (JournalDraftService.requireAutoReverseFeature, JournalPostingService) but not on submit; the app keeps Submit for posting enabled.
suggestedFix: Refuse submit in the backend with "Reverse automatically isn't part of your plan right now. Untick it to go on." and disable Submit in the editor while the box is ticked and the feature is off.

findings.text: Draft JV-DRAFT-000034 shows the box ticked with "Reverse automatically isn't part of your plan right now." but Submit for posting is enabled; toast "Journal JV-DRAFT-000034 submitted / It waits for someone else to check and post it." (DB SUBMITTED, auto_reverse = t). The poster then gets a refusal he can't fix.
Builder decision 1 → change: block Submit too, or refuse on submit.

title: Opening-balance journal shows a branch on lines that have none in the DB
rootCause: The opening-balance import writes branch_id only on the mapped bank lines; the 2000 Share capital and 2098 Opening balance equity lines are saved with NULL branch, while the journal detail shows the default branch "Lahore HQ" on every line.
suggestedFix: Backend: put the chosen branch on every line the import creates (or the company's required branch). App: show the line's real branch, not the header default.

findings.text: OB-2026-27-000001 shows Branch "Lahore HQ" on all 4 lines, but journal_lines.branch_id is NULL on 2000 and 2098.
Trial balance filtered to Lahore HQ puts the equity side under "Other branches and lines without a branch 325,000.00 Cr".

title: Invoice draft with an empty line description is saved but can't be opened
rootCause: Save draft returns an error to the app although the server created the draft; the detail of that draft fails every time. The empty line description is the likely trigger (other drafts open). Not traced to app decode vs backend response.
suggestedFix: Either refuse the save when a line has no description (the footer already says "Line 1: Describe the line.") or make the save response and detail tolerate an empty description. Make the stuck draft openable/deletable.

findings.text: Save draft shows "We couldn't confirm that this went through. Reload before trying again." but INV-DRAFT-000027 was created; opening it always shows the same message with Back only. Retrying creates duplicates; it can't be edited or deleted.

title: Auto-added empty line in document editors loses typed text and can't be removed
rootCause: The invoice/bill editor appends a trailing empty line as soon as line 1 gets text; the recomposition drops the rest of the text being typed, and the trailing line comes back after Remove and on reopen.
suggestedFix: Add the trailing line without moving focus or recomposing the field being typed in (or add it on blur); let Remove line hide it or don't render it as a removable line.

findings.text: Typing "Shore power, December" in line 1 Description left only "Shore p"; the editor auto-added an empty Line 2 and the rest was lost.
The trailing empty "Line 2" can't be removed: Remove line does nothing (line comes back).
Typing a line description adds an empty "Line 2" at once; reopening a saved draft shows that empty Line 2 again, pushing Tags/pickers down.

title: Accrual panel suggests 2950 Accrued interest instead of 2960 Accrued expenses
rootCause: AccrualDialogState picks the first active account of the ACCRUAL subtype in chart order, which is 2950 Påløpt rente; Accrued income and Deferred income get no suggestion at all.
suggestedFix: Map each kind to a specific account (or a per-account usage flag) instead of the first account of the subtype; suggest 2960 for Accrued expense.

findings.text: Balance account suggested as "2950 Påløpt rente" with hint "Suggested for this kind; you can change it." Had to change it to 2960 by hand.
Same on all three accruals: suggested 2950 changed to 2960 each time.
Bjørn's accrual: Balance account suggested 2950 again.
Accrued expense → 2950 Påløpt rente; Accrued income → empty ("Select…"); Prepaid expense → 1700 Forskuddsbetalt leiekostnad; Deferred income → empty.

title: Recurring journals write Norwegian text into English screens
rootCause: RecurringOccurrences fills {period} and the writer name using the company's ledger language (LedgerText.Language.NB → "Gjentakende bilag: {name}", "nov. 2026"), while the app is English and the editor's Dates list says "Nov 2026".
suggestedFix: Decide which language document text uses. Make the preview, the Dates list and the created journals agree, and show the creator as "Created by recurring journal {name}" in the app language rather than a stored Norwegian string.

findings.text: Created journal memo "Office rent nov. 2026, Oslo HQ", document reference "Lease A4T-OSL nov. 2026", created_by_name "Gjentakende bilag: A4T Rent Oslo"; preview then reads "Office rent des. 2026".
JV-DRAFT-000030/31 memos "Old fee mar. 2026" / "Old fee apr. 2026", created_by_name "Gjentakende bilag: A4T Old fee".

findings.device: iPhone 18 Pro portrait; iPad mini portrait
findings.text: Written by / Submitted / timeline read "Gjentakende bilag: A4T Rent Oslo"; spec says "Created by recurring journal A4T Rent Oslo".

findings.device: iPad mini portrait; iPad Pro 13 portrait
findings.text: Timeline "Written/Submitted by Gjentakende bilag: A4T Bjorn Rent".

title: Override count is wrong, and switching a feature off and on leaves an explicit ON row
rootCause: The Modules stats count module overrides but miss the branch override (known T8-1, still open); a feature switched off and back on is stored as an explicit company ON instead of returning to INHERIT, and the screen doesn't count it.
suggestedFix: Compute "Overrides in force" from the same data as the matrix; offer "Same as agreement" (back to INHERIT) when switching on, and confirm an explicit ON doesn't keep a feature the agreement later drops.

findings.text: Kystgruppe shows "2 Overrides in force · 2 modules · 0 features" while the matrix shows one branch override (Bergen · Finance "Set for this branch") and HRMS has none.
Switching Refunds back on stores an explicit ON row; stats still "2 Overrides in force · 2 modules · 0 features".
RECURRING_JOURNALS and JOURNAL_CSV_IMPORT now explicit company ON (was INHERIT); no "same as agreement" choice.

title: Platform Overview says Kystgruppe's books start is "Not planned" although it is live
rootCause: The platform Overview reads a go-live field that is not set for seeded live companies (or reads the wrong source).
suggestedFix: Show the Accounts setup's go-live state/date; check the seed sets it for Kystgruppe.

findings.text: Overview: "Books start in NeoERP: Not planned — chosen at go-live" for Kystgruppe, which has posted journals since Jan 2026.

title: Opening items can't be created at a company that requires a branch on lines
rootCause: The go-live opening-items wizard (Receivables/Payables hand-off) has no Branch field and the file has no branch column; Lahore requires a branch tag on lines, so the backend refuses with "A line tag is missing or invalid". Very likely the unexplained old T16 hand-off error.
suggestedFix: Add a Branch (default) field to the opening-items wizard and/or a branch column in the file, pass it to the backend; or let the backend use the company's default branch.

findings.text: "Create 2 balances" → amber "That didn't work. Nothing was changed."; server log AccountsRefusal: "A line tag is missing or invalid". Steps 4-5 blocked.

title: Stockholm has no branches in the app: SIE default branch picker empty, journal has no Default branch
rootCause: The app's Org data for Stockholm has no branches (company menu shows only "Stockholm Handel · All branches") although neoerp_org.branches has an ACTIVE branch STO. The SIE footer reads branches from orgDimensions → OrganizationRepository.loadOverview(); unclear whether the API omits them or the app drops them.
suggestedFix: Trace /api/org/companies for Stockholm: make it return STO, or fix the app mapping; then the SIE Accounts step and the journal header get the branch.

findings.device: iPad Air 13 portrait, iPad Air 13 landscape, iPhone 17 portrait
findings.text: Default branch ("Choose a branch") doesn't open; "Choose a default branch to continue." stays and Next stays off. Steps 6-7 blocked.
Journal header has no Default branch field at Stockholm; lines can't be given branch STO.

title: iPad journal grid: line pickers don't open by touch
rootCause: The desktop-style journal grid's dropdown cells (Account, Branch, Cost centre) take focus on tap but don't open their list on touch; they rely on typing or keyboard. Lists that do open are misplaced.
suggestedFix: Open the cell's picker on tap (touch) with a search field, anchored to the cell and above the keyboard; or use the card layout on touch devices.

findings.device: iPad mini portrait/iPad mini landscape; iPad Pro 13 landscape
findings.text: Account/Cost centre cells take focus but no list opens on iPad mini; on iPad Pro 13 the Account list opened once without search, typing "6800" closed it. A journal can't be written on an iPad.
Confirmed: tapping the Account cell of line 1 focuses it but no list opens (all journal tests then done on the iPhone).
Recurring editor grid: the account list opened only when typing (first character only, "6300" filtered on "6").
Account picker list opens about 40 pt below its cell (gap between "5010" field and "5010 Lokalhyra") with the keyboard up.

title: Draft-mode recurring journal with blank amounts can't be saved
rootCause: App and backend contracts disagree: RecurringMapper.toBody sends a blank-amount DRAFT line without a side; RecurringBodies.line requires side on every line (C-14) → 400 "Invalid request fields".
suggestedFix: Agree the contract (C-14 says every line has an account and a side): have the app send the side for blank-amount lines, add a contract test.

findings.text: Line 2 2960 with blank amount, Save → red banner only "Check the fields and try again."; server AccountsRefusal "Invalid request fields". Draft mode's main purpose doesn't work.

title: iPad mini portrait: sticky footer buttons don't respond to taps
rootCause: In the mobile band (744 pt portrait) some sticky-footer buttons get no tap (likely an overlapping layer or hit area); rotating to landscape makes them work.
suggestedFix: Find the layer over the footer in the mobile band (e.g. the auto-added grid line or a scrim) and fix hit testing; add a size test that taps the footer buttons at 744 pt.

findings.text: Save on the new recurring journal did nothing (6 taps over 2 min, no request reached the gateway, no message); in landscape one tap saved.
"Earlier imports" in the Import journals sticky footer didn't respond (3 taps); after rotating to landscape one tap opened it.

title: Pages, counts and pick lists don't refresh after someone else acts
rootCause: Screens keep their first load: no refresh on resume/focus or after another person's change; cached reference lists (projects) are reused; list counts don't update after the app's own navigation.
suggestedFix: Refresh detail/list and badge counts on resume/focus (or show "This changed — reload"); invalidate cached dimension lists when opening an editor.

title: Feature off/on: late pick-up, discarded input, wrong breadcrumb, missing notices
rootCause: Entitlement changes reach the app only on return to the front (and on a throttle when switching on); open forms are dropped silently; the history page and breadcrumb don't know the feature-off state; read endpoints stay open while off.
suggestedFix: Re-check entitlements on focus without throttle for ON; tell the user when a form is closed by a switch; route the "Import journals" crumb to the feature-off spot; show the off notice on Earlier imports; keep header/breadcrumb on the off page; confirm whether reads should be refused.

findings.text: Half-filled "Record refund received" panel thrown away with no message when the page turned into the off page.
While off on the server, the open panel still loaded the supplier's open credit (Pays back list); only writes are refused.

Switch back ON reached the app only on the second return to the front (~1 min); OFF was picked up on the first.
1 minute after the switch the open app still offered New accrual or prepayment (picked up after Home → reopen; not re-reported).

title: Amount and date fields: letter keyboard, stuck keyboard, no formatting
rootCause: Amount/date text fields use the default keyboard type, accept letters, don't format on blur, and on phone date filters the keyboard can't be dismissed.
suggestedFix: Use decimal/number keyboard types with a Done accessory, filter non-numeric input, format on blur, select-all-replace on focus; fix the date filter's focus so the keyboard dismisses.

The write-off Amount field accepts letters (ended as "1500,00CASE-DEMO-7").

title: Refusals are generic or shown out of view
rootCause: Server refusals are mapped to a generic banner at the top of the page; specific reasons (missing tag, invalid field, duplicate name, discarded) are not shown next to the action or the field, and some states have no next action.
suggestedFix: Show the refusal next to Save/the field and scroll to it; map known refusal codes to specific words; give a next action (Upload again / Earlier imports) after a discarded check.

findings.text: "Check the fields and try again." at the top only, no field marked, while the user is at Save.
"Another recurring journal is called A4T Rent Oslo." appears only at the top; tapping Save at the bottom shows no reaction.
"That didn't work. Nothing was changed." although the server sent "A line tag is missing or invalid".
After someone else discarded the check, the page shows "This check was discarded. Nothing was created." and an empty card with no next action.
Builder decision 23 → change: put the words next to Save / the field.

title: Opening-balance import wizard: hand-off and history gaps
rootCause: The OB import and its hand-off don't keep state across steps (fix requires re-upload), discarded/failed imports keep actions or rows, status labels lag the real step, and the journal has no link back.
suggestedFix: Keep the handed-off file when going back to Upload (make the stepper tappable); hide the hand-off on discarded imports; detect format before storing, or don't list format refusals; show the real step and resume there; link the journal's Source to the import; decide on creating missing accounts.

Discarded lahore-tb.xlsx import still shows "Held out" with Enter as opening items for 200,000.00 and 150,000.00.
Every refused wrong-format file is still stored and listed: "CSV lahore-tb.xlsx · Could not read the file"; FAILED rows for PDF and .xls.
Imported files shows "Ready to check" for an import past Check; Continue reopens at "Step 2 of 4 · Check".
Journal Source "From CSV file lahore-tb.csv · 19 Nov 2026" is not a link back to the import.

title: Journal import: no way back from a journal or the menu to its import; own check doesn't resume
rootCause: Imported journals don't show their source line; the New journal ▾ menu has a Journal imports entry only while the feature is off; Import journals always opens a fresh Upload.
suggestedFix: Show "Imported from {file} by {person}, key {key}" linking to the import; keep a Journal imports entry when on; resume the person's own PREVIEWED check; show who discarded a row.

findings.text: JV-DRAFT-000039 has no "Imported from kystgruppe-a4t-good.csv by Anna Lindh, key ACC-A4T-01" line; no link back.
New journal ▾ has no Journal imports; "Imported files" lists opening balances only and says "No files imported yet".
Import journals opens on Step 1 · Upload, not Anna's unfinished check (DB PREVIEWED).
History "By" shows the uploader even when someone else discarded it; Created rows have no link to their journals.
Builder decision 30 → change: keep a Journal imports entry when on too.

title: Automatic reversal: Period close doesn't name it, cancel isn't in the timeline
rootCause: Period close has no text for the new pending-reversal check code (falls back to the generic message); cancelling an automatic reversal writes no journal event.
suggestedFix: Add the "Automatic reversals not posted" check text with the journal and Reverse now; record the cancel (who, reason) as a journal event shown in What happened.

Cancel while off also not in the timeline (known A4).

title: Journals search ignores the document reference
rootCause: JournalJdbcAdapter's text search covers number_display, draft_ref and memo only, not voucher_ref, although the placeholder says "Number, draft, document or memo".
suggestedFix: Add voucher_ref (document reference) to the search clause.

findings.text: Search "EST-A4T-3" → "No posted journals match"; "JV-2026-000003" finds it.

title: Recurring journals editor and list behaviour
rootCause: Gaps against the decided behaviour: no Next preview while creating, Insert leaves the cursor before the token, ended journals drop out silently, list opens pre-filtered, breadcrumb misses the recurring journal.
suggestedFix: Show "Next: …" while creating; put the cursor after the token; show an Ended notice and keep it findable; don't preselect Needs you (or say the list is filtered); include Recurring journals / {name} in the breadcrumb.

findings.text: No "Next: …" preview under the field while creating; Insert places {period} with the cursor before it.

Builder decisions 11 and 12 → change (cursor after token; Next preview while creating).

title: Reports: filters dropped between tabs; GL has no dimension column
rootCause: Each report tab keeps its own filter state (drill keeps it, tab switch doesn't); the GL table has no column for the filtered dimension.
suggestedFix: Share dimension filters across report tabs; add a Cost centre/Project column to the GL when filtered (or always).

findings.text: General ledger has no Cost centre column (Date, Number, Description, Debit, Credit, Balance only).
Cost-centre filter dropped when switching P&L → TB → GL; TB first shows an empty area ~5 s.

title: Company switch on a report page shows "We couldn't find this"
rootCause: After a company switch the current route keeps the old company's report id/state and resolves to not-found.
suggestedFix: On company switch, navigate to the same area's list/report for the new company (or the dashboard).

findings.text: Switching Lahore Textiles → Sialkot Mills on Reports → Trial balance shows "We couldn't find this / It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong. / Back to list".

title: Pickers on touch: two taps, list under the keyboard, picker stays open
rootCause: Form/report dropdowns auto-focus a search field so the keyboard covers the list; the first tap only outlines the field; a picker doesn't close after choosing, so typing goes into its search (with a quick-add row).
suggestedFix: Open on first tap; place the list above the keyboard (or don't auto-focus search on touch); close the picker on selection and move focus on.

findings.text: Every report filter needs two taps, then the list opens under the keyboard; Return doesn't pick the single match.

title: Editors behave differently on Cancel and Tags
rootCause: Invoice/bill editors don't use the journal editor's dirty-check on Cancel; Tags visibility rules differ between invoice and bill lines.
suggestedFix: One rule for all editors: ask "Leave without saving?" when dirty; show Tags the same way on invoice and bill lines.

findings.text: Cancel on New invoice / New bill with a typed line leaves at once; New journal asks "Leave without saving? Your changes to this draft are lost."
Tags hidden until an account is chosen on the invoice line, but shown at once with "Default expense account" on the bill line.

title: Side menu opens under a panel; taps go through to rows behind
rootCause: The navigation drawer is drawn below the open month panel (z-order), so taps reach the page behind it.
suggestedFix: Draw the drawer above panels (or close the panel first); block taps to the content behind an open drawer.

findings.text: With the month panel open, the menu opened under it; the tap on "Reports" opened Apr 2026, which has an enabled "Close Apr 2026". A wrong tap could close a month.

title: Dimensions: new values valid from today; viewer sheet too thin; no quick add
rootCause: New project/cost centre/value forms default Valid from to today; the read-only sheet shows only Status/Valid/Used; cost-centre pickers have no quick add (possibly by design: setup data is link-only).
suggestedFix: Default Valid from to the start of the open period or leave it empty; show code, name, Part of and Group only in the viewer sheet; confirm whether cost centres get quick add (update the script if not).

Accrual Cost centre picker: "Nothing matches "zzq"." with no Add "zzq" (script expects quick add).

title: Slow loads: blank pages and long skeletons
rootCause: Journal/editor/report loads take 4-8 s on the simulators; some pages show a blank card instead of a skeleton. Unclear whether backend latency or app sequential loads.
suggestedFix: Measure the requests behind the journal editor/detail and TB; load in parallel; always show a skeleton.

title: Typed characters or taps lost right after a panel or field opens
rootCause: Input arrives before the panel's layout/focus settles (~0.5-1.5 s) and is dropped. May partly be the simulator's fast typing, but seen in many forms.
suggestedFix: Check focus handling when sheets/panels open (don't recompose the focused field); try on a real device before deciding.

rootCause: Panels and editors keep a tall sticky footer (summary + buttons) above the keyboard; on phones and with the keyboard up on iPads it covers the focused field, picker lists and grids.

rootCause: Content above the touch target changes height after an action (error line, caption, collapsing section, re-read) and the page moves, so the next tap or typed text lands elsewhere.

title: Period close on iPad mini portrait: title one letter per line, empty Status column
rootCause: The Period close header is laid out in a zero-width column in the mobile band; the Status column has no content there.
suggestedFix: Fix the header's width constraint at 744 pt and fill the Status column (or drop it to the card layout).

title: Automatic reversal wording
rootCause: Card and dialog texts don't distinguish pending from done and omit the consequences.
suggestedFix: "Will be reversed automatically on …" until it posts; keep the reversal-date line with the FY warning; say the automatic one is dropped in the Reverse dialog; use the reversal's date; tell the poster to Reject.

suggestedFix: List row: next memo and last journal number; mark document reference required in Waiting to post; hide the reverse line when unticked; add "· n" count; human ended reason; Dismiss says what it does; specific writer-block reason.
